test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 08 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**A sentence has been given with a blank to be filled with an appropriate option. Choose the correct alternative.**

When there is not ______ to eat, people starve to death.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3'** i.e. **'Enough'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **sentence is talking about **the lack of a sufficient amount of something.
 
• **"enough"** is the appropriate word to indicate insufficiency.
 
• The **phrase** should read "not enough to eat".
 
• **"enough"** (पर्याप्त) means to the required degree or extent.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'When there is not enough to eat, people starve to death.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Some" **is used to refer to a certain unspecified amount or number.
 
• **"Any"** generally refers to one or some of a thing or number of things, no matter how much or how many.
 
• **"A few" **refers to a small number of something but is not suitable in this context.
